verdicts.note: Promised later cards would show a prefix for binary; only the 0x hex prefix is taught. Reworded.
'2 multiplied by itself n times' is off by one; now 'n copies of 2 multiplied together'.
'Too small' percentages were ambiguous (2.4% is relative to the estimate, 10% at 2^40 was 9% relative to the true value). Restated as the true value being bigger.
Removed the NIST binary-prefix reference, which does not support a card about word size.
kibi/mebi/gibi are not 'spoken' kilo-binary; they are short for it. Case remark applied only to kB vs KiB, not MB vs MiB.
Worked example (64 KiB = 65,536) gave away the answer of the 64 KiB problem card. Changed to 4 KiB.
'Emoji 4 bytes' is not universal; some symbol-style emoji are 3 bytes. Now 'most emoji'.
UTF-16 byte order is unspecified, so '0x00 0xE9' was ambiguous. Now one 16-bit unit 0x00E9.
Answer line described the effect but not what overflow is; it now states both. Softened 'hardware doesn't raise an error'.
